name: Garnier Hair Food Pineapple
description: arnier Fructis Hair Food Pineapple Mask 400ml is a versatile and nourishing product that works in three different ways to provide nourishment and strength to long, fragile hair. For that purpose, the formula features a nourishing complex with pineapple extract, shea butter, omegas 6 and 9, and fatty acids. This complex works to hydrate and soften the hair. Additionally, vitamins C, E, and F deliver hydration, strength, and shine to the hair. Nourishment is a key feature, as the inclusion of these ingredients provides deep conditioning that contributes to hydrated and soft hair. Furthermore, the formula also helps reduce split ends, being ideal for thin hair prone to breakage.
